description: This file defines the Assignment entity class used in the Learning Management System backend, representing an assignment with properties such as id, courseId, title, description, due date, maximum points, and creation date.

classes.name: Assignment
classes.description: Entity class representing an assignment with properties and constructors, mapped to the 'assignments' database table.

methods.name: Assignment(Long, String, String, Instant, int)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize an Assignment with specified courseId, title, description, dueAt, and maxPoints.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the assignment.

methods.name: getCourseId()
methods.description: Returns the course ID associated with the assignment.

methods.name: getTitle()
methods.description: Returns the title of the assignment.

methods.name: getDescription()
methods.description: Returns the description of the assignment.

methods.name: getDueAt()
methods.description: Returns the due date of the assignment.

methods.name: getMaxPoints()
methods.description: Returns the maximum points achievable for the assignment.
